data.rationale: The revision-bound independent command ran once and all 12 behavior cases passed. Scenario coverage is 18 of 21, above the 70% gate; the two prior failed behaviors passed on the current revision.
data.exceptions: Branch coverage was not measured because no instrumentation command was authorized. S13 unavailable FD CLI, S20 archived FD rejection, and S21 write-failure rollback remain uncovered; none is treated as passed.
data.residual_risk: The recovery rollback under a filesystem write failure lacks runtime evidence. Reviewer must inspect the static rollback path and return any actual defect to Worker.
